source: Wahapedia datasheet 000000924 (Abaddon the Despoiler), The Warmaster: "If your army is Battle-forged, this model must be your WARLORD. If more than one model from your army has a rule to this effect, then one of those models must be your WARLORD." (research library 03_Codexes/Chaos/Chaos_Space_Marines.md §6: must be Warlord unless a Primarch is present).

Wahapedia datasheet 000001377 (Mortarion), Daemon Primarch: "If your army is Battle-forged, this model must be your army's WARLORD. If more than one model in your army has a rule to this effect, then one of those models must be your army's WARLORD."

Wahapedia datasheet 000001031 (Magnus the Red), Daemon Primarch: "If your army is Battle-forged, this model must be your army's WARLORD. If more than one model in your army has a rule to this effect, then one of those models must be your army's WARLORD." (research library 03_Codexes/Chaos/Thousand_Sons.md §6: must be Warlord).

Research library 03_Codexes/Chaos/World_Eaters.md §6 (Angron: "Must be Warlord"). The Wahapedia snapshot's Angron datasheet (000002621) lists only three abilities and leaves this rule out; BSData v9.8.0 also makes his Warlord compulsory. Treated like the other Daemon Primarchs: when another unit in the army must be the Warlord too, one of them must be.

Wahapedia datasheet 000000129 (Roboute Guilliman), The Avenging Son: "If your army is Battle-forged, this model must be your army's WARLORD, even if another model in your army has a rule to this effect." The entry is shared by every Space Marine chapter catalogue, so this covers Guilliman in all of them.

Wahapedia datasheet 000002479 (Morvenn Vahl), High Lord of the Imperium: "If your army is Battle-forged, this model must be your army's WARLORD. If more than one model in your army has a rule to this effect, then one of those models must be your army's WARLORD." (research library 03_Codexes/Imperium/Adepta_Sororitas.md §11: must be Warlord).

Wahapedia datasheet 000001446 (Trajann Valoris), Captain-General: "If your army is Battle-forged, this model must be your army's WARLORD. If more than one model from your army has a rule to this effect, then one of those models must be your army's WARLORD." (research library 03_Codexes/Imperium/Adeptus_Custodes.md §5: must be Warlord).

Research library 03_Codexes/Imperium/Astra_Militarum.md §2 (Detachment abilities, Chain of Command): "If Lord Solar Leontus is in the army, he must be Warlord." The rule is the codex's Astra Militarum detachment ability, not on his Wahapedia datasheet (000002605); BSData v9.8.0 also makes his Warlord compulsory.
Wahapedia datasheet 000002360 (The Silent King), The Silent King: "If your army is Battle-forged, Szarekh must be your army's WARLORD."

Wahapedia datasheet 000000008 (Ghazghkull Thraka), Grand Warlord: "If this model is included in your army, it must be your WARLORD." (research library 03_Codexes/Xenos/Orks.md §6: Ghaz must be Warlord).

Wahapedia datasheet 000000407 (Commander Shadowsun), Hero of the Empire: "If your army is Battle-forged, this unit's COMMANDER SHADOWSUN model must be your army's WARLORD. If more than one model in your army has a rule to this effect, then one of those models must be your army's WARLORD."

Wahapedia datasheet 000000406 (Commander Farsight), Enclave Commander: "If your army is Battle-forged, this model must be your army's WARLORD. If more than one model in your army has a rule to this effect, then one of those models must be your army's WARLORD."
